observations: Tran Cao et al., Journal of Gastrointestinal Surgery, 2017; retrospective single-institution cohort of major hepatectomies without biliary-enteric anastomosis (Jan 2009–Jun 2015), n=318.

entities.name: Air leak test and OSI
observations: In 318 major hepatectomy patients, organ-space infection occurred in 5.2% with intraoperative air-leak testing (n=210) versus 13.0% without testing (n=108), p=0.015; retrospective observational association, not proof of causality.
ALT patients had a higher proportion of trisegmentectomy (53% vs 34%, p=0.002), a potential group imbalance.
